questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some pillows are doors.

Some doors are beds.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some doors are pillows.

II. All beds are doors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2007af74394f42ee9d2c974ac86f616ca8f95aa387d8e152e1360dee278b0228.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some doors are pillows. → True (as some pillows are doors)

II. All beds are doors. → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, **"only conclusion I follows" **is the correct answer.

**Here, the digits of the first number in the series are multiplied to get the second number, then the digits of the second number are multiplied to get the third number and so on.**

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of the mathematical signs to replace Xs in the below equation and thereby balance it.

9 X 3 X 6 X 2 X 9
questions.solution:
Given expression : 9 X 3 X 6 X 2 X 9

1) Replacing Xs with ÷, ×, =, × in the same order, we get

9 ÷ 3 × 6 = 2 × 9

Applying BODMAS rule on L.H.S and R.H.S, we get

L.H.S = 9 ÷ 3 × 6

= 3 × 6

= 18

R.H.S = 2 × 9

= 18

**L.H.S = R.H.S **

2) Replacing Xs with ÷, ×, =, - in the same order, we get

9 ÷ 3 × 6 = 2 - 9

Applying BODMAS rule on L.H.S and R.H.S, we get

L.H.S = 9 ÷ 3 × 6

= 3 × 6

= 18

R.H.S = 2 - 9

= -7

**L.H.S ≠ R.H.S **

3) Replacing Xs with ×, =, -, ÷ in the same order, we get

9 × 3 = 6 - 2 ÷ 9

Applying BODMAS rule on L.H.S and R.H.S, we get

L.H.S = 9 × 3

= 27

R.H.S = 6 - 2 ÷ 9

= 6 - 0.22

= 5.78

L.H.S ≠ R.H.S 

4) Replacing Xs with ×, ÷, +, = in the same order, we get

9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 2 = 9

Applying BODMAS rule on L.H.S and R.H.S, we get

L.H.S = 9 × 3 ÷ 6 + 2

= 9 × 0.5 + 2

= 4.5 + 2

= 6.5

R.H.S = 9

L.H.S ≠ R.H.S 

Hence, **"÷, ×, =, ×"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If the price of a certain product is first decreased by 35% and then increased by 20%, then what is the net change in the price of the product?
questions.solution:
Let the price of the product be Rs 100

When the price is decreased by 35%, it becomes 100 - 35% of 100 = 100 - 35 = 65

Then it is increased by 20%. It becomes 65 + 20% of 65 = 65 + 13 = 78

Net change in the price of the product = {(Original Price - Changed Price)/Original Price} × 100

= {(100 - 78)/100} × 100

= 22

Hence, **22% **is the correct answer.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement: **

Some fans are swords.

All swords are fishes.

**Conclusion:**

I. All fans are fishes.

II. All swords are fans.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

The least possible Venn diagram is :

Conclusion:

I. All fans are fishes. → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. All swords are fans. → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, **neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

questions.question: There are six fruits A, B, C, D, E and F. A is sweeter than D but not as sweet as B. E and B are not as sweet as F. D is sweeter than C. E is sweeter than A. Which fruit among the six is the least sweet?
questions.solution:
A is sweeter than D but not as sweet as B.

 
• B > A > D

D is sweeter than C.

 
• B > A > D > C

E and B are not as sweet as F. E is sweeter than A. 

 
• Case 1 : F > E > B > A > D > C
 
• Case 2 : F > B > E > A > D > C

In both the cases, C is the least sweet fruit.

Hence, **C** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

Therefore, the pattern followed here is :

Row 1 : (14 - 6) × 3 = 8 × 3 = 24

Row 2 : (13 - 7) × 3 = 6 × 3 = 18

Row 3 : (9 - 4) × 3 = 5 × 3 = 15

Hence, **15** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Directions: Read the information given below carefully and answer the questions accordingly:

Rashmi stepped out of her college and walked 15 m towards South. She then took a left turn and walked 35 m to reach a pastry shop. She then took a right turn and walked 15 m. She then took a right turn and walked 35 m to reach her house. What is the approximate shortest distance between Rashmi's college and her house via the pastry shop?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d25a89d96ac5e50d35af588b991b2736fc5066fa067fe15e9ca1a2038e1bc8a7.png] 

The path followed by Rashmi is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b4abf8bea6a272ecc70e8758b03e902027d0113aa37c7aa37bbc53f955ae84e.png] 

Using Pythagoras theorem to get the shortest distance :

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Height)²

Shortest distance between college and pastry shop = √((35)² + (15)²)

= √(1225 + 225)

= √(1450)

= 38.07 m ≈ 38 m

Shortest distance between house and pastry shop = √((35)2 + (15)2)

= √(1225 + 225)

= √(1450)

= 38.07 m ≈ 38 m

Shortest distance between college and house via pastry shop = 38 + 38 = 76 m

Hence, **76 m** is the correct answer.

The shortest distance between ice cream parlour and central park can be calculated using the Pythagoras theorem.

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Height)²

= √225 + 900

= √1125

= 33.5

Hence, **33.5 m** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of the mathematical signs that can be filled to balance the following equation:

12__4__2__2__5__3
questions.solution:
1) +, =, ÷, ×, + 

Given expression is 12__4__2__2__5__3

Replacing __ with mathematical signs and applying BODMAS rule, we get :

12 + 4 = 2 ÷ 2 × 5 + 3

L.H.S = 12 + 4 

= 16

R.H.S = 2 ÷ 2 × 5 + 3

= 1 × 5 + 3

= 5 + 3

= 8

**L.H.S ≠ R.H.S**

2) ÷, ×, +, =, +

Given expression is 12__4__2__2__5__3

Replacing __ with mathematical signs and applying BODMAS rule, we get :

12 ÷ 4 × 2 + 2 = 5 + 3

L.H.S = 12 ÷ 4 × 2 + 2

= 3 × 2 + 2

= 6 + 2

= 8

R.H.S = 5 + 3

= 8

**L.H.S = R.H.S**

3) ÷, ×, -, =, ×

Given expression is 12__4__2__2__5__3

Replacing __ with mathematical signs and applying BODMAS rule, we get :

12 ÷ 4 × 2 - 2 = 5 × 3

L.H.S = 12 ÷ 4 × 2 - 2

= 3 × 2 - 2

= 6 - 2

= 4

R.H.S = 5 × 3

= 15

**L.H.S ≠ R.H.S**

4) ÷, ×, =, +, +

Given expression is 12__4__2__2__5__3

Replacing __ with mathematical signs and applying BODMAS rule, we get :

12 ÷ 4 × 2 = 2 + 5 + 3

L.H.S = 12 ÷ 4 × 2

= 3 × 2

= 6

R.H.S = 2 + 5 + 3

= 10

**L.H.S ≠ R.H.S**

Hence, **÷, ×, +, =, +** is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are two numbers. The difference between these two numbers is 2 and the difference between their squares is 8. What are those numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the smaller number be 'x' and bigger number be 'y'

y - x = 2 → equation 1

y² - x² = 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a6f7be4d5ac7a61ed75080b7fd76eb51511cbe580fa8d1cf807c9b9d05e75a3.png] **a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)**

(y + x)(y - x) = 8

(y + x) × 2 = 8

y + x = 4 → equation 2

Solving equation 1 and 2, we get

y = 3

x = 1

Hence, **3, 1** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five women are sitting in a row. One of the two women at the extreme ends is sharp and the other one is creative. A thin woman is sitting to the right of a strong woman. A fragile woman is to the left of the creative woman and the strong woman is sitting between the sharp and the thin woman. Counting from right, what is the place occupied by the fragile woman?
questions.solution:
Let us fix the end positions first. It is given that one of the two women at the extreme ends is sharp and the other one is creative. Here two case arises :

Case 1 : Women at the left end is sharp and women at the right end is creative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9448207eaf2a2b8b6fff206a89cbc98dd3dbd343024d6913160d2133b8195d85.png] 

Case 2 : Women at the left end is creative and women at the right end is sharp.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c388d5cf11d2a662bd822c4cb0de11e4707a826f21d677915c84049fae95e5f.png] 

A fragile woman is to the left of the creative woman and the strong woman is sitting between the sharp and the thin woman.

In case 2, creative woman is on the left end so seating fragile women on the left of creative women is not possible. Therefore, we reject case 2.

Considering case 1, we get :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/913294ef7776584e0884a163452d01749a3bb9f3fd526f9fdf0f51d28c88e442.png] 

So, counting from right fragile woman occupies second position.

Hence, **second** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Amit is younger than Arjun by 6 years. If the ratio of the ages of Amit and Arjun is 5 : 7, then what is the age of Amit (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Amit be 'x' years.

Age of Arjun = x + 6 years

Ratio of the ages of Amit and Arjun is 5 : 7

Therefore, 

x/x + 6 = 5/7

⇒ 7x = 5(x + 6)

⇒ 7x = 5x + 30

⇒ 2x = 30

⇒ x = 15

Amit's age is 15 years.

Hence, **15** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If '+' means 'divided by', '-' means 'add', '×' means 'minus' and '÷' means 'multiplied by', what will be the value of the following expression: [{(21 × 17) - (3 ÷ 2)} + (3 - 2)] ÷ 2
questions.solution:
Given expression : [{(21 × 17) - (3 ÷ 2)} + (3 - 2)] ÷ 2

'+' means 'divided by', '-' means 'add', 'times' means 'minus' and '÷' means 'multiplied by'

Replacing the symbols according to the question, we get

[{(21 - 17) + (3 × 2)} ÷ (3 + 2)] × 2

Applying the BODMAS rule, we get

[{4 + 6} ÷ 5] × 2

= [10 ÷ 5] × 2

= 2 × 2

= 4

Hence, **4** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

begin{array}{*{20}{c}} 9&4&?\ 5&8&5\ {28}&{24}&{42} end{array}
questions.solution:
Let the missing term be 'x'.

The pattern followed here is :

***In a colmun:***

***(First number + Second number) × 2 = Third number***

Column 1 : (9 + 5) × 2 = 14 × 2 = 28

Column 2 : (4 + 8) × 2 = 12 × 2 = 24

Similalry,

***Column 3 : (x + 5) × 2 = 42***

***x + 5 = 21***

***x = 21 - 5***

***x = 16***

Hence, **16** is the correct answer.

questions.question: O, P, Q, R, S and T are six sisters who are good at knitting. T is better than S. Q is better than R. O is better than P. Q is not as good as P. S is better than O. Who among the six is the best at knitting?
questions.solution:
T is better than S.

T > S

Q is better than R.

Q > R

O is better than P.

O > P

Q is not as good as P.

P > Q

S is better than O.

S > O

Combining all the relations, we get

T > S > O > P > Q > R

Hence, **T** is best at knitting.
